title: One file per task, backlog item and decision, and one order file
description: Serves Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need.", by letting tasks run side by side. Seen now: tasks/prd.json changed in 63 of the last 100 commits and decisions.json in 48, with conflicts between parallel branches reported (monorepo study §1). D-133.
acceptanceCriteria: Each task, open or done, is one file named by its id; each backlog item and each decision is one file. A count taken before and after, recorded once, matches.
One order file lists the open task ids in priority order, and only the product owner changes it. Tasks have no priority field; done is a status, and files never move.
New decisions are named D-<YYYYMMDD>-<slug>; existing ids keep theirs.
One command lists the plan (open tasks in order, one task, the open backlog) from the files; no generated index is committed.
AGENTS.md, the product owner's role and the build workflow read and write the files. Two tasks merged in parallel afterwards touch no shared plan file but the order file.
